# Octree

> Octree is an AI-powered LaTeX editor designed for research writing, academic collaboration, and document generation with built-in templates and tools.

Octree provides a comprehensive platform for LaTeX document creation, combining an intelligent editor with free tools, extensive templates, and learning resources. The platform serves researchers, academics, and students who need professional typesetting capabilities with modern collaboration features.

## Key Topics

- LaTeX
- TikZ
- AI-powered editing
- Research writing

- PGFPlots
- BibTeX
- Collaborative editing
- PDF generation

- Scientific writing
- amsmath
- geometry package

## Getting Started

- [Octree – AI LaTeX Editor](https://www.useoctree.com): Octree: AI-powered LaTeX editor for research writing with collaboration and templates
- [About Octree](https://www.useoctree.com/about): Company mission and overview of Octree AI-powered LaTeX editor
- [Octree App](https://app.useoctree.com): Octree app login and authentication for AI-powered LaTeX editing
- [Pricing & Subscription](https://app.useoctree.com/buy): Octree pricing and subscription plans for LaTeX editor access

## LaTeX Learning Resources

- [Learn LaTeX – Complete Beginner Tutorial](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/latex): Comprehensive LaTeX beginner guide covering syntax, math, tables, citations
- [Learn TikZ – Create Diagrams in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/tikz): TikZ tutorial for creating diagrams, flowcharts, and graphics in LaTeX
- [Learn PGFPlots – Create Plots in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/pgfplots): PGFPlots tutorial for publication-quality charts and data visualization
- [Greek Letters and Math Symbols Reference](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/greek-letters-math-symbols): Complete LaTeX reference for Greek letters and mathematical symbols

## LaTeX Formatting Guides

- [Bold, Italics and Underlining in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/bold-italics-underline): LaTeX text formatting guide for bold, italic, underline styling
- [Page Size and Margins in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/page-size-margins): LaTeX geometry package guide for page size and margin configuration
- [Subscripts and Superscripts in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/subscripts-superscripts): LaTeX math mode guide for subscripts, superscripts, and notation
- [LaTeX Lists – Itemize, Enumerate & Description](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/lists): LaTeX list creation guide for itemize, enumerate, and description lists

## Templates & Tools

- [Octree LaTeX Tools](https://tools.useoctree.com): Free LaTeX toolkit: TikZ generator, image converter, 70+ templates, live editor
- [60+ Free LaTeX Templates](https://tools.useoctree.com/templates): 60+ free LaTeX templates for resume, thesis, beamer, research papers

## API Reference

- [Compile API Documentation](https://www.useoctree.com/docs/compile-api): REST API docs for Octree LaTeX compilation service with caching
